⭐ Typing Rules

  1. Look at the word and picture.
  2. Press the speaker to hear the word.
  3. Type the exact English word.
  4. Press Enter or Check.
  5. Repeat until you reach 15 correct attempts.

📝 My Computing Exams

Try a short age-appropriate review after learning. Teacher guidance is recommended.

Exam rules / စာမေးပွဲစည်းကမ်း

Read or listen to each question carefully. Choose one answer. You can try again to improve your score. A pass is 70% or higher. These are practice assessments, not formal accredited examinations.
